profile.name: 是德科技 DSOX2024A 数字示波器
profile.description: 一台台式数字示波器，用于观察、采集和测量电压信号随时间变化的波形。它支持多通道输入、触发控制、时基与垂直量程调节，以及自动测量功能，常用于电子电路调试、信号时域分析和实验室波形记录。
profile.description_en: A benchtop digital oscilloscope used to view, acquire, and measure voltage waveforms over time. It supports multi-channel inputs, trigger control, timebase and vertical scaling adjustments, and automated measurements, making it suitable for electronics debugging, time-domain signal analysis, and laboratory waveform capture.
